title: Regression Testing & Test Strategy
objectives: Turn every fixed bug into a permanent regression test
Pick stack-appropriate levels: cargo test, Vitest, API tests, Tauri commands
Write a one-page team test strategy

examples.name: strategy.md
examples.code:
# Test strategy (one page)

- Unit: all domain logic (Rust lib, TS modules) — every PR
- Integration: DB repos, stores — nightly
- Contract: API shapes — on schema change
- E2E: 5 critical journeys — before release
- Rule: every bug fix ships with a regression test

exercise.prompt: Assign each check to its CI slot: "lint + typecheck", "unit tests", "full integration suite", "E2E smoke of checkout" against slots "every PR", "nightly", "before release".
hints: PR gates must finish in minutes or people skip them.
E2E cost is fine when it guards a release.

options: every bug fix ships with the test that would have caught it
questions.explanation: Regression tests anchor fixes permanently so the same bug cannot silently return.

questions.prompt: For a Tauri app, the most practical automation level is…
options: full UI screenshots of every screen
command-level tests over the lib crate
browser E2E against the dev server
questions.explanation: Tauri commands are the app API: testing the lib crate exercises engine + DB without a webview.
